provenance.permission: Used with the agreement of NECC, given by e-mail in October 2026.
provenance.method: The last price NECC printed for this centre in the month shown, read by tools/fetch-necc-prices.mjs. Nothing is averaged or estimated.
provenance.clarification: The daily egg prices suggested by NECC, on its official website or through any other medium (including verbal, print and digital media) are merely suggestive and not mandatory. The suggested prices are published solely for the reference and information of the trade and industry. NECC does not by itself or through any person enforce compliance or adherence with such suggested egg prices in any manner whatsoever.
provenance.attribution: National Egg Co-ordination Committee (NECC), Daily Rate Sheet for 2026-10, https://www.e2necc.com/home/eggprice, read on 28/10/2026.
